model: muse-spark-1.3 (Meta Model API), the photo marking prompt in witness/src/witness_photo.erl
paper: sample paper made for the demo (not a real student): Year 9 Mathematics, Percentages and Money, 2 pages photographed on a desk

question_4.diagnosis: Took the 50% decrease as $50 off the $150 instead of 50% of $150.

fingerprint.intervention: Have the student calculate what 50% of $150 actually is and compare it to the $50 subtracted to see which amount the decrease is of.
fingerprint.misconception: second change taken from original amount
fingerprint.reasoning: Calculated the increase to $150 correctly but then subtracted $50, which is 50% of the original $100, instead of 50% of $150.
